title: Two Women Seated on Wooden Bench, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot photograph depicting two young women sitting together on a simple wooden bench in a grassy outdoor yard. The woman on the left wears a light floral patterned house dress, while the woman on the right wears a white short-sleeved dress with stylish 1940s ankle-strap wedge shoes.
